name: @meridian/indexer
description: WS-06: Envio HyperIndex indexer for Meridian (per-block funding, oracle APR, positions, vault, swaps).

scripts.test: envio codegen && node scripts/gen-config.mjs test && ENVIO_CONFIG=config.test.yaml vitest run --test-timeout=20000 --exclude 'test/hosted/**'
scripts.test:hosted: envio codegen --config config.hosted.testnet.yaml && ENVIO_CONFIG=config.hosted.testnet.yaml vitest run test/hosted --test-timeout=60000; s=$?; envio codegen; exit $s
